## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and what this change delivers.

## Issues

Closes #<implemented-subissue>
Refs #<parent-issue>

## Validation

Record commands, results and any Android/API/ABI actually tested. Link raw evidence
when testing device behavior. Distinguish a successful build from execution.

## Limits and follow-up

List material limitations and follow-up issues. Keep parent issues open until
their complete acceptance criteria are verified.

- [ ] Branch is linked to the primary issue; issue/board status is current.
- [ ] Tests, documentation and changelog cover the delivered behavior.
- [ ] CI is green; unimplemented features remain explicitly unavailable.
